finding.query: Orama.js WASM vector search schema definition

research_notes.finding: Pattern: create({ schema: { field: 'type(embedding|vector)' } }) - Use 'vector(384)' for 384-dimensional embeddings - Supports full-text search fallback - Custom filters via schema properties - Persistence via orama.save() / orama.load()
Pattern: pipeline('feature-extraction', 'Xenova/clip-text-en') - 384-dimensional embeddings (CLIP ViT-B/32) - Outputs tensor, need to convert to array - Supports batching for performance

Finding: Web Workers essential for embedding generation - Offload CPU-intensive tasks from main thread - IndexedDB storage for index persistence - WASM bundles can be large (~100MB for CLIP) - Lazy load model to improve initial load time

architecture_patterns.pattern: Pattern: Class-based index management with async initialization - Constructor initializes Orama instance - Public methods for CRUD operations - Private methods for internal logic
Pattern: Persistence middleware with Dexie adapter - persist() middleware with custom storage - IndexedDB for larger data sets - Graceful fallback to localStorage
Pattern: Off-main-thread processing via workers - Worker script loaded dynamically - Message passing for input/output - Error handling with worker termination

technical_notes.note: WASM Bundle Size: CLIP model is ~100MB - Implement lazy loading for embeddings model - Show progress indicator during model download - Provide fallback to server-side embeddings if needed
IndexedDB Quota: Browser storage limits apply - Implement LRU eviction for old embeddings - Monitor storage usage and warn at 80% - Provide manual cleanup option in settings
Performance Target: <100ms search for 1000 documents - Use Web Workers for embedding generation - Implement query result caching - Consider approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) for scale
File Size Constraint: 300 lines per file - Split orama-index.ts into smaller modules - Separate concerns: schema, persistence, search
